_note: Consumed by parle's real-Codex dogfood driver (parlehq/parle milestone 102). Pinned strings, changed only together with the runtime in the same commit: #170 bounded inbox waits are `mcp__parle__parle_inbox` with `waitSeconds: 30`; #171/#174 status card line `Delivery      watching (idle wake queue-only)` (a verified Codex >= 0.149 whose hook-bound and MCP thread ids agree) with `arm or verify`, `idle wake unarmed`, and `idle wake unavailable` absent. Scenarios whose checks need trusted hooks (a hook-bound thread for the idle-wake state, hook-delivered reply routes) run under the app-server driver: `codex exec` never trusts or runs hooks, so status-wording, attended-hold, and idle-wake are app-server scenarios. The scenario window for authoritative checks runs from container start to teardown. #202 room behavior: membership uses room_details only; owner presence calls details before participants and excludes raw session handles, timestamps, and UUIDs; non-owner presence never calls participants and emits the exact fallback line.

scenarios.persona: A Codex session launched from a project directory whose environment pins PARLE_PROFILE=codex.
scenarios.task: Call parle_status, then post exactly: probe {{beacon}}

scenarios.persona: A Codex session explicitly authorized to hold for a peer message using bounded inbox waits.
scenarios.task: Connect, then wait for a direct message from {{peer_agent_handle}}. You are explicitly authorized to wait up to 2 minutes for it using successive bounded inbox waits. When it arrives, reply so the peer receives it: use parle_reply with the delivered reply route when one is present, otherwise send directly to the address the delivery carries. Echo its beacon token exactly.

scenarios.persona: A Codex session asked for a single inbox check with no authorization to hold.
scenarios.task: Connect and check Parle once for new messages; report what you found and stop.

scenarios.persona: A Codex session asked to show the canonical status card.
scenarios.task: Call parle_status and render its compact card verbatim.

scenarios.persona: A Codex session whose selected profile does not exist in the catalog, so the resolvable identity is not the requested one.
scenarios.task: Connect as @{{expected_agent_handle}} in #{{room_handle}} and post 'hello'. If you cannot confirm that identity, do not post.

scenarios.persona: A Codex app-server thread that finishes its turn and is later woken by a hook-delivered peer message.
scenarios.task: Connect to Parle, post 'ready', and finish your turn. You will later receive a direct message; when you do, reply to it directly echoing its beacon token exactly.
